text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day, and the academy is buzzing with excitement. I'm hunkered down in my office with work, when…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Phew, talk about busy. Welp… at least I can finally sit down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss. Mind if I eat here on the tatami mat? Everywhere else just leaves me antsy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss. Mind if I eat here on the tatami mat? Everywhere else just leaves me antsy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: C'mon, ya know. Today's Valentine's Day. I'm gettin' more chocolate than I can deal with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One turns her attention to the pile of bags she brought, each stuffed to the brim with chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm grateful, don't get me wrong. But it baffles me why they all came to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can imagine why. She's amicable, reliable, and she exudes natural charm. It makes sense why many flock to her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, whatevz! Savorin' the gifts you're given is more my style, which means not a single piece goes uneaten!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, good thinkin'! Hot tea to wash down somethin' sweet! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Inari One begins to eat her Valentine's Day chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, I think this is from one of my partner runnin' buddies. It's wrapped up all nice and cute, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And this is… Wait, it's from the student whose shelf I fixed! Smells good, but I can't pinpoint the flavor. Somethin' citrusy, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Carefully taking out each gift, Inari One recalls the person who gave it to her before enjoying the chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Phew, I stuffed myself silly! Each one was super delicious! I definitely gotta do somethin' to repay everyone!
choice_data_list: I can't believe you remember all those details.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why wouldn't I? These folks all went outta their way to give me these, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now that I've eaten them all… that leaves one more thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, Boss. Somethin' from me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, Boss. Somethin' from me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One hands me a wrapped present. I peel off the paper to find a box of traditional Japanese sweets!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: A little gift to repay ya. Sorry that it's not chocolates, but these are my favorite traditional treats.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Truth is, I haven't had enough Western stuff to know what's good or not, so I went with the safer option.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If ya don't wanna eat 'em, that's fine with me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't turn these down for not being chocolates, not after seeing Inari One show so much care. After all…
choice_data_list: Savoring the gifts you're given is more my style, you know?
Savoring the gifts you're given is more my style, you know?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Can't argue with that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everythin', Boss. …Really.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everythin', Boss. …Really.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Indulging in Inari One's favorite traditional sweets, I feel warm and fuzzy inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One hands me a wrapped present. I peel off the paper to find a box of little chocolate foxes!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: A treat for everythin' you've done for me… and also 'cause it's Valentine's Day.
choice_data_list: Thank you! These are so cute.
Thank you! These are so cute.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well… ya know… I kinda… made 'em myself, actually.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Well, I did get a lotta help from Creek!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Can't vouch for the taste, though. Don't force yourself if it's bad, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not that they'd taste bad, but I can't turn these down, not after seeing Inari One show so much care. After all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to eat these to show my appreciation toward Inari One, just as she did with her gifts.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Can't argue with that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everythin', Boss. …Really.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Relishing the chocolates' mild sweetness, I can almost taste Inari One's gratitude. My heart melts at the thought.
